title: Getting Started with 3rd Party Integrations on Avalanche L1s I Avalanche Summit London
description:
Andrea Vargas, Senior Developer Relations Engineer at Ava Labs, gives a short introduction into the many integrations compatible with Avalanche L1s, designed to enhance functionality and scalability for your blockchain projects.

Avalanche is a high-performance blockchain platform designed for builders who need to scale. Engineered with a revolutionary three-part Layer 1 (L1) architecture, Avalanche is anchored by its Avalanche Consensus Mechanism, ensuring near-instant finality for transactions. The platform also features an open-source Layer 0 (L0) framework, enabling the seamless creation of interoperable Layer 1 blockchains with high throughput on both public and private networks.

Supported by a global community of developers and validators, Avalanche offers a fast, low-cost environment for building the next generation of decentralized applications (dApps). With its unique blend of speed, flexibility, and scalability, Avalanche is the preferred choice for innovators pushing the boundaries of blockchain technology.

Learn More & Join the Avalanche Community -
Website: https://avax.network​
X: https://x.com/avax​​
Discord: https://chat.avax.network
Forum: https://forum.avax.network/

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a conference workshop about third-party integrations for Avalanche L1 blockchain development. The speaker discusses developer tooling, account abstraction, block explorers, data feeds, and Builder Hub access for developer profiles and hackathons. These are described as technical resources rather than investment returns, payment demands, credential requests, or deceptive outcomes.
